response.sql: WITH projects_with_qc AS (SELECT DISTINCT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux FROM projects p INNER JOIN scanqc sq ON p.arcregistry = sq.arcref), funding_groups AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as distinct_project_count FROM projects_with_qc GROUP BY fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(distinct_project_count) as total_projects FROM funding_groups), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(distinct_project_count) as avg_projects FROM funding_groups) SELECT fg.fundflux, fg.distinct_project_count, fg.distinct_project_count::float / t.total_projects as fraction_of_total, fg.distinct_project_count::float / a.avg_projects as divided_by_average FROM funding_groups fg CROSS JOIN totals t CROSS JOIN avg_calc a ORDER BY fg.fundflux
